using namespace std;

static vector<int> fact;
static vector<int> ifact;
static const int fmod = 998244353;

int fpow(int a, int b) {
    if (a == 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    int ans = 1;
    while (b > 0) {
        if ((b & 1) > 0) {
            ans = fmul(ans, a);
        }
        a = fmul(a, a);
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return ans;
}

int fmul(int a, int b) {
    return (int)((long long)a * b % fmod);
}

int ifact_func(int x) {
    if (ifact[x] > 0) {
        return ifact[x];
    } else {
        return ifact[x] = fpow(fact[x], fmod - 2);
    }
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, k, ans = 0, mult = 1;
    cin >> n;
    long long kl;
    cin >> kl;
    
    fact.resize(n + 1);
    ifact.resize(n + 1, 0);
    
    if (kl >= n) {
        cout << 0 << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    k = (int)kl;
    
    fact[0] = fact[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; ++i) {
        fact[i] = fmul(fact[i - 1], i);
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i <= n - k; ++i, mult = -mult) {
        int add = mult * fmul(fpow(n - k - i, n), fmul(fact[n - k], fmul(ifact_func(i), ifact_func(n - k - i))));
        while (add < 0) {
            add += fmod;
        }
        ans += add;
        if (ans >= fmod) {
            ans -= fmod;
        }
    }
    ans = fmul(fmul(ans, fact[n]), fmul(ifact_func(k), ifact_func(n - k)));
    cout << (k == 0 ? ans : fmul(ans, 2)) << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
